housing.summary: Numbeo reports a June 2026 average of EUR 1,500 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Waterford city centre; Daft.ie provides current Waterford City rental listings. The Residential Tenancies Board says a landlord cannot ask for a deposit above one month's rent, but a Waterford-specific typical deposit was not established: https://rtb.ie/renting/rights-responsibilities/security-deposits/

banking.summary: AIB says a personal bank-account applicant must provide the original of one photo ID and one proof of address; someone not currently resident in Ireland needs two proof-of-address documents.
required_docs: One original valid photo ID, such as a signed passport, passport card, travel document, EU/EEA photographic driving licence, or EU national identity card
One proof-of-address document issued to the home address within the past six months; two are required if not currently resident in Ireland

schools.summary: HeadStart provides a Waterford primary- and secondary-school directory. Waterford-specific availability of international curricula such as IB, British, French, or American was not established.

legal_admin.summary: People from outside the EU, EEA, UK, or Switzerland who intend to remain in Ireland for more than 90 days must register their permission with Immigration Service Delivery within 90 days of arrival. First registrations nationwide are by appointment at the ISD Registration Office in Dublin.
legal_admin.registration_step: Book an appointment with Immigration Service Delivery and attend the first-registration appointment with the required documents and any applicable fee.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who needs a Personal Public Service Number for a valid reason can apply through MyWelfare with a basic MyGovID account, book the required in-person appointment during the application, and bring the requested documents.

transport.summary: TFI Leap Card identifies Bus Éireann Waterford City services and lists an adult Waterford City Red Zone monthly ticket at EUR 54. Driving-licence exchange depends on the issuing jurisdiction. The HSE provides online applications for medical cards and GP visit cards.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid EU/EEA licence can be used while valid and may be exchanged; a licence from a recognised state can be exchanged, while holders of non-exchangeable licences must complete the Irish learning-to-drive process: https://www.ndls.ie/licensed-driver/exchange-my-foreign-driving-licence.html
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply online for a medical card or GP visit card and provide PPS numbers, dates of birth, and income and expense details: https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/medical-cards/applying/apply/
